風のとおり道 (インストゥルメンタル)
となりのトトロ －エンディング主題歌

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1988 (Japan).

physical: Made by Tokuma Japan Communications Co., Ltd.

notes.text:
Soundtrack to Hayao Miyazaki's animated film My Neighbor Totoro (1988)

Limited vinyl LP pressing. With liner notes and four pages of illustrations.

A1: Sanpo - ōpuningu shudaika = Stroll - Opening Theme
A2: Gogatsu no mura = The Village In May
A3: Obake ya shiki! = A Haunted House!
A4: Mei to susuwatari = Mei And The Soot Gremlins
A5: Yūgure no kaze = Evening Wind
A6: Kowakunai = Not Afraid
A7: Omimai ni ikō = Let's Go To The Hospital
A8: Okāsan = Mother
A9: Chīsana obake = A Little Creature
A10: Totoro
A11: Tsukamori no taiju = The Huge Tree In The Tsukamori Forest
A12: Maigo = A Lost Child
B1: Kaze no tōri michi (Insuturumentaru) = The Path Of The Wind (Instrumental)
B2: Zubunure obake = A Soaking Wet Creature
B3: Tsukiyo no hikō = Moonlight Flight
B4: Mei ga inai = Mei Is Missing
B5: Neko basu = Cat Bus
B6: Yokattane = I'm So Glad
B7: Tonari no totoro - endingu shudaika = My Neighbor Totoro - Ending Theme
B8: Sanpo (gasshō-tsuki) = Stroll (With Choir)

Stamped runouts
